# Imports
```{r}
if(!require("deSolve")) install.packages("deSolve")
library("deSolve")
```

### SIR model
```{r}
SIR_model <- function(time, state, params){
  S <- state["S"] # susceptible population
  I <- state["I"] # infected population
  alpha <- params["alpha"] # rate at which infected host leaves this class (dies or recovers)
  beta <- params["beta"] # rate at which susceptible becomes infected (increase of infected pop)
  K <- params["K"] # carrying capacity, max pop size of a specific population, given by r/alpha, intrinsic growth rate divided by the coeff of intraspecific competition"
  r <- params["r"] # intrinsic growth rate of the population
  
  dS <- (r * (1 - (S/K))) * S - (beta * S * I)
  dI <- (beta * S * I) - (alpha * I)
  
  return(list(c(dS, dI)))
}
```

### Parameters definition
```{r}
state <- c(S=2, I=0.1)
params <- c(
  alpha=0.2,
  beta=0.5,
  K=2,
  r=1
)

time <- seq(0, 50, by = 1)
out <- ode(
  state,
  time,
  SIR_model,
  params
)
epid_thresh <- params["alpha"] / params["beta"]  # = 0.4
# --- Vector field grid ---
S_seq <- seq(0.01, 2.5, length.out = 20)
I_seq <- seq(0.01, 2.5, length.out = 20)
grid  <- expand.grid(S = S_seq, I = I_seq)

# Compute derivatives at each grid point
dS_vec <- numeric(nrow(grid))
dI_vec <- numeric(nrow(grid))
for(k in seq_len(nrow(grid))){  
  state_k <- c(S = grid$S[k], I = grid$I[k])  
  derivs <- SIR_model(0, state_k, params)[[1]]  
  dS_vec[k] <- derivs[1]  
  dI_vec[k] <- derivs[2]
  }
# Normalize arrow lengths for readability
magnitude <- sqrt(dS_vec^2 + dI_vec^2)
scale <- 0.08  # adjust this to make arrows longer/shorter
dS_norm <- scale * dS_vec / magnitude
dI_norm <- scale * dI_vec / magnitude
df.out <- as.data.frame(out)

plot(
  df.out$I~df.out$S,
  xlab="S",
  ylab="I",
  #xlim=c(0, 1.5),
  #ylim=c(0,5)
  )

arrows(  
  x0 = grid$S,  
  y0 = grid$I,
  x1 = grid$S + dS_norm,
  y1 = grid$I + dI_norm,  
  length = 0.04, # arrowhead size 
  col = adjustcolor("steelblue", alpha.f = 0.5),  
  lwd = 0.8
  )
abline(v = epid_thresh, col = "blue")
abline(a = 1/0.5, b = (-1/(2*0.5)), col = "red")
legend(
  "topright",  
  legend = c("Trajectory", "S nullcline threshold", "I nullcline"),
  col = c("black", "blue", "red"),
  lty = c(1, 2, 2),
  lwd    = 2
  )

```
